concepts.title: Limits
learningObjectives: Explain the intuitive meaning of a limit.
Explain how limits are used to define derivatives.
concepts.masteryAssessment: Evaluate a limit and explain how it relates to the definition of a derivative.

concepts.title: Derivatives
learningObjectives: Explain the derivative as an instantaneous rate of change.
Apply derivatives to calculate velocity and acceleration.
concepts.masteryAssessment: Given a position function, derive its velocity and acceleration.

concepts.title: Velocity and Acceleration
learningObjectives: Distinguish position, displacement, velocity, and acceleration.
Derive velocity and acceleration from a position function.
Interpret velocity and acceleration as vectors.
Apply derivatives to analyze the motion of a physical system.
concepts.masteryAssessment: Given the position of a particle as a function of time, calculate and interpret its velocity and acceleration.
